aggregation: unweighted per-coordinate mean of finite word spectral values
selection: maximum validation full-pool MRR; deterministic first grid entry on ties within 1e-12
word_count_basis: one-hot training-observed word counts plus an unseen-count bucket; same basis in all spectral arms and structural controls
eligibility: all original seed-42 train/validation observations in zuco1_duration_qc; no new exclusions; no test extraction
gaussian: independent per-word/coordinate draws using only real training-word mean/population SD; exact source per-coordinate missingness and word counts
duration_units: stored sample counts at 500 Hz; not milliseconds; inclusive raw snippet N=duration+1 in audited examples

useful_validation_screen.interpretation: descriptive gate, not a significance test; one previously used validation split

test_policy: this runner has no test extraction or evaluation path; report validation decision only
